name: x-follows-list
description: X Takip Denetimi — Chrome-only following checker (MV3). No dependencies.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8')); console.log('manifest.json OK')"
scripts.release: npm run check && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -r -X -q "dist/x-follows-list-v$(node -e "console.log(require('./manifest.json').version)").zip" background.js content.js popup.html popup.js manifest.json icons README.md -x '*.DS_Store'
